subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should local model-cost estimates stay USD-only, or should OpenClaw define a non-USD currency contract for configured model prices?
rationale: This adds public config and changes cost display/accounting semantics across schema, status output, Usage UI, diagnostics, docs, and mixed-provider aggregation.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, persisted-field semantics, and docs before implementation.

options.title: Keep configured costs USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD local estimates and keep non-USD facts in provider-reported billing surfaces only.

options.title: Allow display-only override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol override while documenting that stored totals, diagnostics, and APIs remain USD-shaped estimates.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, persisted-field semantics, and docs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent cost analysis and provider billing work that this config decision must coordinate with.
